description: Plan v7 section 8.3: the numeric limits at their DEFAULTS, with no override, so a port cannot ship different default values unnoticed. Absolute scale 1024 versus 1025 is expressed compactly as 1E+1024 and 1E+1025 (BigDecimal scale -1024 and -1025). Visible decimal places 1024/1025 and compact exponent 64/65 straddle DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_VISIBLE_DECIMAL_PLACES and DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_COMPACT_EXPONENT; note that those two exceed-side values are rejected by the PluralOperands.Builder itself, which seeds its own limits from TranslationRuntimeLimits.defaults(), so they surface as a throw from operand construction rather than a resolution failure. That is the library's real behavior and is what the oracle records.
